g.text: The same attack path, three different outcomes
What does Zero Trust stop, and what can still happen after we press pause?
Fourteen source-classified checkpoints compare a broken mediation relay, a guarded clean wallet and a guarded wallet with prior exposure.
One disclosed chain. Three explicit starting conditions.
Cumulative signing intents are model outputs, not real signatures. Settlement and delegated activity use separate channels.
